tuningBudget: Seven decoder operating points per learned candidate; label wording/windowing fixed before acquisition. No repeated inference for thresholds.
selectionRule: Diagnostic: greatest recall at observed >=95% provisional segment agreement precision, with at least one match. If none qualifies or no scored videos, preserve published/default configuration and abstain from model selection. This is not a release gate.
sourcePolicy: Model/adapters/decoders/runtime pins unchanged from successful v3 tuning; no adaptation after holdout exposure. Reporting/tuning-validation changes are separate.
